author: maxim-kurin
title: TestKerasLSTM test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 numerical accuracy mismatch with dropout
signature: test keras lstm flags numerical mismatch with dropout float32|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: TensorFlow Layer Tests / TensorFlow Layer Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 fails: OpenVINO CPU inference output diverges from TensorFlow/Keras reference beyond tolerance

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check failed because the TensorFlow Layer Tests job failed

root_cause: This is a known, recurring flaky test in the TensorFlow Layer Tests suite: test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 compares OpenVINO CPU inference output against a TensorFlow/Keras reference for an LSTM layer configured with dropout (dropouts=(0.1,0.3)) enabled during inference. Keras applies dropout stochastically based on its own RNG seeding even in what is meant to be a deterministic comparison, so the TF reference output varies slightly run-to-run while OpenVINO's LSTM kernel computes a fixed, non-stochastic result; the two diverge by about 0.1 in this run, above the test's 5e-2 epsilon. The merge-queue PR (#39559) only touches the Intel NPU compiler adapter (src/plugins/intel_npu) and is unrelated to the TensorFlow frontend or CPU LSTM kernel, confirming this is not caused by the PR under test. This exact signature has recurred 8 times since 2026-08-27 across unrelated PRs.
reproduction_steps: Run locally: `pytest tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_lstm.py::TestKerasLSTM::test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 -k "dropouts" -v` repeatedly; the dropout-enabled parametrization is expected to occasionally diverge from the TF reference by more than the 5e-2 epsilon due to Keras's internal RNG for dropout masks not being pinned.
recommended_actions: Pin/seed TensorFlow's dropout RNG (e.g., tf.random.set_seed plus a fixed dropout seed) in the test fixture so the Keras reference output is reproducible, or disable dropout at inference time (model.predict uses training=False, but the Keras dropout layer call path in this test should be audited to confirm training mode is not leaking into inference).
Mark the `dropouts` parametrization of test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 as flaky/xfail or increase its epsilon specifically for cases where dropout > 0, pending a proper RNG-seeding fix.
No action required on PR #39559; it can be safely merged/re-queued once this unrelated CI issue is retried.
prevention_strategies: Add deterministic seeding for any TensorFlow/Keras layer that uses internal randomness (dropout, initializers) in layer_tests comparison fixtures, and track known-flaky layer test parametrizations in a dedicated skip/xfail list with a tracking ticket so merge-queue runs are not blocked by them.
historical_context: Recorded 8 times since 2026-08-27 (pattern a284d27dfee44614), most recently 2026-11-16, across PRs #37611, #37654, #38168, #39121, #39286, #39341, #39270, #39742. A related but differently-signatured instance of the same underlying test (pattern 134f01149f41adcc) was also seen 3 times in mid-2026. Always resolved by retry/rerun since the PRs under test were unrelated to the TensorFlow frontend or CPU LSTM kernel.
